Name: Sebastian Post Flower Dance Apology
Author: kristinthered
Description:
[size=3][u]Sebastian Apologies for Not Wanting to Dance with You!
[/u]Are you tired of Sebastian not wanting to dance with you at the Flower Dance? Even if you are married? 

Well, this mod adds a post-Flower Dance apology scene for the moody fella. Let it soothe your broken heart, if only for a few moments.



[u]About Me:[/u]
I am pretty new to creating Stardew Valley mods, but I am a pretty fast learner! I'm currently working on a mod to improve gameplay after year 4. 

If you want to support my work, please consider buying me a coffee at [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/kristinthered]https://www.buymeacoffee.com/kristinthered

[/url]Also if you have any ideas for mods that you would like to see, please leave them in a comment! [/size]
